label: Shape proxies vs published AP, 439 OAM-TCD, masker arms on one detector
purpose: establish whether corner/fill/centre track segmentation accuracy, so the dryland whitening ablation (reported only in these proxies) can be read directionally
caveats: dryland proxies were GT-box prompted; these arms are predicted-box
arms differ in the MASKER only (same detector family), so this speaks to masker changes, not to cross-architecture comparison
3 of the 5 arms are seeds of one configuration, so they cluster in AP

verdict.headline: NEGATIVE for ranking. `corner` separates a gross box-filler from a working masker, but does NOT rank working configurations.
verdict.evidence: Pearson(corner, AP50) = -0.865 looks strong, but it is carried entirely by the single beta=0 outlier (corner 0.939, AP50 0.579). Spearman is -0.100, i.e. no rank relationship. Within the four beta=0.5 arms, corner RISES 0.232 -> 0.424 while AP50 also rises 0.6203 -> 0.6294: over the working range the proxy moves WITH accuracy, opposite to the assumed direction. n=5 arms, 3 of them seeds of one configuration, so the rank statistic is weak regardless.
verdict.consequence_for_whitening: The dryland -whiten delta (corner 0.37 -> 0.44) sits in the WORKING range, not the gross-failure range (the within-box-contrast failure is 0.61, and beta=0's box-filler is 0.94 here). Since the proxy does not rank working configurations, that shift cannot be read as an AP degradation, and the earlier '~30% of the way to the failure mode' reading is NOT supported. The dryland whitening ablation shows whitening changes the posterior's shape; it does not establish that whitening improves accuracy. Settling it needs the TCD refit (deferred item 1, ~$8).
verdict.what_it_does_establish: The proxy is a valid DEGENERACY detector: beta=0's fill 0.98 / corner 0.94 / centre 0.999 is the box-filler signature, cleanly separated from every beta=0.5 arm. Used that way -- as a failure-mode flag, not a quality score -- it is sound.

sanity: beta=0, beta=0.5 vanilla and knobbed s0 all report 159,687 instances: the same detector seed 0 boxes, masker varied. Box count is masker-invariant, as expected.
